# DeadEnd AI

> A working prototype that finds and preserves why technical approaches were rejected, with inspectable public GitHub evidence and human review.

Website: https://deadend-ai-codersinpune.vercel.app/
Source code: https://github.com/nikkushrivastava0-a11y/deadend-ai
About and product limitations: https://deadend-ai-codersinpune.vercel.app/about.html
Privacy and permitted inputs: https://deadend-ai-codersinpune.vercel.app/privacy.html

## What the product does
- Import an individual public GitHub issue or pull request, including relevant comments, or paste permitted project notes.
- Identify explicitly rejected technical approaches and preserve exact evidence quotations and source links.
- Let a person correct, approve, dispute or reject findings.
- Download a Markdown handover containing approved public findings.
- Explore the evidence workflow through an interactive 3D visual or accessible mobile fallback.

## Important limitations
- It is a public/synthetic demonstration, not an authenticated enterprise workspace.
- Its live extraction is deterministic; a production AI model is not configured.
- Private GitHub repository authentication is not implemented.
- Separate /team.html supports individual custom scrypt accounts, role invitations, durable shared PostgreSQL records and recipient receipts. The anonymous demo remains browser-scoped.
- Team accounts have no email verification, password recovery, MFA or OAuth.
- A GitHub import can return no candidates when it lacks explicit evidence.

## How to verify
Try the example case in the web app, inspect its source quotation, approve a finding, then download the handover. More information: https://deadend-ai-codersinpune.vercel.app/about.html
